scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,mlr-backend,mlr-frontend -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w mlr-backend" "npm run dev -w mlr-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w mlr-backend && npm run build -w mlr-frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w mlr-backend && npm test -w mlr-frontend
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w mlr-backend && npm run coverage -w mlr-frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w mlr-backend && npm run lint -w mlr-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w mlr-backend && npm run typecheck -w mlr-frontend
